title: CarbonMote
tagline: Unveiling an innovative protocol integrating IoT motion capture for sustainable, transparent carbon reduction. Enabling global participation, this tech-driven approach ensures eco-conscious actions for a greener future.
description:
Introducing a pioneering protocol that revolutionizes carbon reduction efforts through the seamless integration of IoT motion capture technology. This cutting-edge approach not only propels us towards a more sustainable future but also fosters global participation in an open and transparent carbon marketplace.

At the heart of this protocol lies the concept of verifiable carbon reduction. By leveraging IoT motion capture along with blockchain technology, every carbon-conscious action taken becomes traceable and accountable. This not only empowers individuals, businesses, and communities to actively engage in carbon reduction measures but also ensures that these efforts are quantifiable and credible. 

In this ecosystem, the carbon marketplace operates as an open platform with innovative initiatives to further reduce carbon emissions, adopt renewable energy sources, or implement energy-efficient technologies. The transparency of the marketplace cultivates a sense of trust, as every action and its impact can be readily assessed and verified.

Furthermore, the impact of this protocol extends beyond the mere reduction of carbon emissions. By intertwining social and environmental factors, it creates a holistic approach to sustainability. As individuals and organizations strive to make meaningful carbon reductions, they are simultaneously contributing to positive social change and environmental preservation. This synergy creates a ripple effect, leading to a more conscientious and interconnected global community.

The protocol's emphasis on transparency and accountability not only addresses the pressing issue of climate change but also cultivates a sense of responsibility and ownership among participants. This collective effort ultimately shapes a more sustainable future, where carbon reduction isn't just a goal but a shared endeavor that transcends borders and backgrounds.

The fusion of IoT motion capture with blockchain technology an open and transparent carbon marketplace elevates carbon reduction into a dynamic, participatory experience. This protocol doesn't just reduce carbon emissions; it cultivates a mindset of sustainable living, fosters impactful changes, and ushers in a future where environmental stewardship is a global norm.
how_its_made: Developed on Android using Kotlin to do basic walking verification (isWalking & DistanceChanging) as a proof-of-concept. The mobile app sends data to a Nextjs webapp through exposed endpoints. the information is saved to a cloud-based postgres instance offered by Vercel. The webapp then allows the user to login using safe{core} Account Abstraction. We utilize the db information to provide an attestation using EAS on Base through our safe{core} safe. based on the distanceWalked information, a certain number of credits may be issued on Base. Each credit is tied to the associated attestation. Information from the deployed contract is gathered through a subgraph developed on subgraph studio.
